According to the CDC, symptoms of monkeypox will appear within 3 weeks of exposure. 

Common symptoms of monkeypox include: 
-Fever 
-Headaches
-Muscle aches
-Swollen lymph nodes
-Chills
-And a rash that can be located on your hands, feet, face, and other areas.

Today I testified in favor of The Maryland Online Data Privacy Act of 2024 (SB 541). Consumers should be able to exercise certain rights when it comes to their personal data online. Protecting privacy online can help consumers avoid fraud and abuse, and we must do what we can to make sure those safeguards are in place.

On #WorldDayofSocialJustice, I stand committed to building a fairer and more equitable place for all Marylanders. From employment and housing to healthcare and our environment, social justice issues impact millions of Marylanders who deserve equal access and fair treatment. Last year, my Office was granted new authority to enforce civil rights. Our Civil Rights Division is growing quickly to ensure we protect the constitutional rights of all Marylanders because we know that social justice and equality go hand in hand.
